messages:
Marta L.: Hey team — PR #4123 updates the v2 migration guide and adds a new Python SDK streaming snippet. Need one reviewer for prose/migration steps and one for the code example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Note: docs preview is currently failing linkcheck per the bot. Would like this merged in tomorrow's 10:00 PT merge window if we can get approvals and CI green.

Sanjay K.: I can take the linkcheck and any broken anchors. Saw one obvious broken anchor in the migration doc. Ping me the file or tag the commit and I'll patch it.

Evan P.: I can review the Python snippet. I'll run it locally and validate streaming behavior. Would prefer a small unit test rather than the current end-to-end that flakes.

Tara W.: I'm on docs rotation and can review the migration prose. @Evan P. can you add a short comment in the snippet about expected response shape and error handling? :+1:

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4123 (status: failing — linkcheck: 2 broken anchors)

Marta L.: Thanks — the broken anchor is in docs/migration/v2.md around the "breaking-changes" heading. I pushed a quick fix to the branch but haven't run CI again. Evan — I added tests/snippets/test_stream_example.py but it's marked flaky; open to your suggestion.

Evan P.: I'll replace the flaky e2e with a small unit test that mocks the stream object and asserts the sequence of yielded chunks. Will also add a comment showing use of "with client.stream(...) as s:" and example cursor handling. Pushing a fix in ~2 hours.

Sanjay K.: After CI is green, I can handle the actual merge at the scheduled window and backport if we need a release branch PR. Who will add the changelog note?

Tara W.: Please add a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md referencing the migration guide update so product/pm can see it. Small note is fine.

Marta L.: Done — added a short line: "migration: v1->v2 endpoint guide and streaming SDK example (PR #4123)" and pushed. Also fixed the anchor and re-ran CI.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4123 (status: passing)

Evan P.: Reviewed the updated snippet and test, left one tiny stylistic comment (use context manager). I approved the PR.

Tara W.: LGTM — approved. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay K.: CI is green. I'll merge during tomorrow 10:00 PT merge window and tag the backport if requested. I'll also add a short note to release-notes.md about the migration docs.

Marta L.: Thank you everyone — I will watch the post-merge preview and verify the redirects and anchors. If anything pops, ping #docs and I'll pick it up.
